summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; nothing was run or committed, so tests are unverified. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent 4 per level, Measurement import added). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or min with explicit width) in __rich_console__, and adds VerticalCenter with render (pad=False, console.size.height, newline padding), measure, and repr. rich/console.py print now uses justify="default" in render options. CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added section (two entries). Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, render, measure, tall-content) and tests/test_tree.py (acceptance measurement Measurement(11, 19), single-node). Unverified risks: existing Align tests and multi-line Text inside Align may change output as the spec allows; tree level counter ends at -1 harmlessly. Nothing was committed.
